sourceOccurrences.label: Loop-erased law and insensitive observables
sourceOccurrences.locator: Named statement start lines in the pinned source: 22, 29, 37, 57, 70, 79, 93, 102, 111
sourceOccurrences.note: LNKT covers deterministic graph invariance, measurable loop erasure, its zero-diagonal pushforward law, and equal laws for measurable diagonal-insensitive observables or events when profiles agree off the diagonal. These statements hold for arbitrary vertex sets. EYCQ covers countable-vertex two-point probabilities, the full extended cluster-volume law and susceptibility, including infinite values. The two-vertex opposite-diagonal example and infinite complete-graph example illustrate the source witnesses. No conditioning on all loops being closed is used.
